post.description: The post, page or custom post type entry whose field values are being written.

fields.description: The fields to write, at most 50, each named once. Every entry is validated before any of them is written: one entry this operation cannot use refuses the whole request and leaves the post untouched.

field.description: One field name or ACF field key, for example subtitle or field_5f3a1b2c. Matched against the fields that apply to the post by key first and then by name.

value.description: The value to store, in the raw form ACF stores rather than the formatted form a read returns: an attachment id rather than an attachment object, a post id rather than a post. Its type follows the field, so none is declared here. Send an empty list [] to clear a flexible content field or a repeater — every row of a flexible content field must be an object carrying an acf_fc_layout naming one of that field's layouts, so null is refused and [] is how every row is removed.

plan.description: The change plan to approve, including its plan token.

target.description: The concrete target that was written.

changed.description: The fields the approved plan changed.

state.description: The verified persisted state of the target.
